# DesignLibrary: A Library of Common Research Designs

[![Coverage
Status](https://coveralls.io/repos/github/DeclareDesign/DesignLibrary/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://coveralls.io/github/DeclareDesign/DesignLibrary?branch=master)
[![CRAN_Status_Badge](http://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/DesignLibrary)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=DesignLibrary)
[![minimal R
version](https://img.shields.io/badge/R%3E%3D-3.4.0-6666ff.svg)](https://cran.r-project.org/)
[![packageversion](https://img.shields.io/badge/Package%20version-0.1.10-orange.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/DeclareDesign/DesignLibrary/commits/master)

**DesignLibrary** provides simple interface to build designs using the
package **DeclareDesign**. In one line of code users can specify the
parameters of individual designs and diagnose their properties. The
designers can also be used to compare performance of a given design
across a range of combinations of parameters, such as effect size,
sample size, assignment probabilities and more.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Installing the design library

To install the latest stable release of **DesignLibrary**, please ensure
that you are running version 3.4 or later of R and run the following
code:

``` r

install.packages("DesignLibrary")
```

If you would like to use the latest development release of
**DesignLibrary**, please ensure that you are running version 3.4 or
later of R and run the following code:

``` r

devtools::install_github("DeclareDesign/DesignLibrary", keep_source = TRUE)
```

## Contributing designs and designers

We welcome contributions to the library!

- You can [submit static
  designs](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/articles/How_to_Write_and_Contribute_Designs.html)
  made in `DeclareDesign`, which will live as properly attributed
  entries in the library on our website
- Or you can [submit designer functions that generate
  designs](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/articles/How_to_Write_and_Contribute_Designers.html),
  which may be added to the CRAN version of the package

------------------------------------------------------------------------

This project is generously supported by a grant from the [Laura and John
Arnold Foundation](https://www.arnoldventures.org) and seed funding from
[Evidence in Governance and Politics (EGAP)](http://egap.org).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`assignment_string()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/assignment_string.md)
  : Generates string of assignment of value to argument
- [`binary_iv_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/binary_iv_designer.md)
  : Create a binary instrumental variables design
- [`block_cluster_two_arm_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/block_cluster_two_arm_designer.md)
  : Create a two-arm design with blocks and clusters
- [`cluster_sampling_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/cluster_sampling_designer.md)
  : Create a design for cluster random sampling
- [`code_fixer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/code_fixer.md)
  : Substitute approach
- [`construct_design_code()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/construct_design_code.md)
  : Generates clean code string that reproduces design
- [`factorial_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/factorial_designer.md)
  : Create a factorial design
- [`get_design_code()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/get_design_code.md)
  : Get the code from a design
- [`match.call.defaults()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/match.call.defaults.md)
  : Argument matching with defaults
- [`mediation_analysis_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/mediation_analysis_designer.md)
  : Create a design for mediation analysis
- [`multi_arm_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/multi_arm_designer.md)
  : Create a design with multiple experimental arms
- [`pretest_posttest_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/pretest_posttest_designer.md)
  : Create a pretest-posttest design
- [`process_tracing_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/process_tracing_designer.md)
  : Create a process-tracing design
- [`randomized_response_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/randomized_response_designer.md)
  : Create a randomized response design
- [`regression_discontinuity_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/regression_discontinuity_designer.md)
  : Create a regression discontinuity design
- [`return_args()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/return_args.md)
  : Generates character string for non-fixed arguments in a designer
  using substitution approach.
- [`spillover_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/spillover_designer.md)
  : Create a design with spillovers
- [`str_within()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/str_within.md)
  : Takes substring between matched strings. Avoids dependency on
  stringr package.
- [`sub_expr_text()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/sub_expr_text.md)
  : Substitute text from expressions in design code
- [`two_arm_attrition_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/two_arm_attrition_designer.md)
  : Create design with risk of attrition or post treatment conditioning
- [`two_arm_covariate_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/two_arm_covariate_designer.md)
  : Create a simple two arm design with a possibly prognostic covariate
- [`two_arm_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/two_arm_designer.md)
  : Create a one-level two-arm design
- [`two_by_two_designer()`](https://declaredesign.org/r/designlibrary/reference/two_by_two_designer.md)
  : Create a two-by-two factorial design
